claim: Uses the Fourier neural operator backbone and adds physical residual losses, including higher-resolution physics constraints.
claim_zh: 在傅里叶算子主干上引入物理损失，并可在更细分辨率评估残差。
innovation_detail: Use a Fourier operator backbone with physical training constraints, sometimes at finer resolutions.
innovation_detail_zh: 在傅里叶算子主干上引入物理损失，并可在更细分辨率评估残差。
bottleneck: Low-resolution paired data and pure supervised fitting may miss fine physical structure.
bottleneck_zh: 低分辨率配对数据与纯监督拟合可能遗漏细尺度物理结构。
tradeoff: PDE residuals increase training cost and do not guarantee universal extrapolation.
